[[File:Godsheart.png|thumb|250px|[[The Godsheart]] was a [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsar]], a rapidly rotating neutron [[Star/Legends|star]].]]
{{Youmay|the star|the [[Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser/Legends|''Neutron Star''-class bulk cruiser]]}}
A '''neutron star''' was the [[Star/Legends|stellar]] material that was left over from a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. Neutron stars had extremely strong [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and could douse their [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in [[Death/Legends|lethal]] [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. A rapidly rotating neutron star was known as a [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsar]].<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref> The chemical element [[illerium]]<ref name="Expert">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Consulting the Expert|Makeb}}</ref> was usually found in neutron stars.<ref name="Isotope-5">{{TORcite|type=codex|Isotope-5}}</ref>
